posts.title: Jab We Met
posts.review:
Geet offers Aditya the open space he wanted, she opens up about herself so that he finds comfort in sharing his problem when they meet. Later on they bond up as both of them reciprocate well. He was broken, cheated upon yet he chose morals. He was with her in fucking Rathlam and still he didn't just go on at Geet to feel better. He was in his darkest phase with so many set backs and still decided to go all in and get her home. He realised the beauty, aura, innocence, sweetnessa and purity Geet holds. He might have fallen in love with her even before she speaks about Anshuman. I know this because I used to at some point consider people coming at my low phase to be universe's sign of love. I know it's totally wrong now. They were just sent to give me some lessons, it's crazy how God knows everything. And i believe he fell in love with her but because she loved someone else he stopped himself and worked on himself. It wasn't Geet that gave him power to rebuild, she just listened to him and 'pakkaved' him with her talks.  

And he trusted,loved and believed in her so much that he left her in the hope that she will be fine with the guy she was in love with. And then when he gets her back he could still proclaim her saying I have grown be mine but he still chose to hear what she feels before getting into her territory. He chose to me humane instead of overpowering her. He helps her recover and get back to her family yet again. And finally she wisely chooses Aditya over the guy who just thought she was crazy and didnt even care to check if that girl who had left her everything for him was ok or not. 

I have watched this movies for 30+ times now and I really was in search for Aditya until I watched BKU.

posts.title: Obsession
posts.review:
It shows how anything too much isn't good. The guy has feelings for her, she gets to know it that's how girls are we just get to know it. She even asks him if you do so, he flusters and says no. Thus he wishes that she gets obsessed in love with him. He gets the karma for the too much he demands for. 
  I could see the elements girls do when they are in love but because he wishes for obsession over just normal love she does it extremely. And the ending was cool, I mean the guy could have got a second chance too for the mistake he did. But you know life's unfair so he dies at the end, and the girl in the rage of obsession kills her two friends. And in that trauma the guy kills himself and the wish which turned as wrath in the life of 4 people gets released. And the girl who was possessed by the wish comes back to normal.

This was my insight from the first time i watched the movie but later on when i watched it again I had different perspective it felt like another movie but I do feel the way the storyline is presented here feels more like watching a vlog over a movie.
